standard.title: CXO Ecosystem Index profile completeness standard
standard.purpose: Measure research depth without treating missing evidence as a negative claim or quality ranking.
standard.scoring_note: Scores describe the completeness of the Index record, not the quality, size, reputation, or suitability of the organization.

research_queue.ordering: Editorial research priority first, then lowest completeness score, lowest fact count, and organization name. Organizations scoring 80 or more move to maintenance.
research_queue.neutrality_note: Queue position controls research workflow only and is not an organization ranking.
